assessment.title: Unit 1 Quiz: Dimensional Analysis & Scientific Notation
assessment.instructions: Ten problems on unit conversions (dimensional analysis) and scientific notation, 25 points. Set up a picket fence on scratch paper for every conversion so the units cancel. Type each answer as a number; you may add the unit (0.0075 kg). For scientific notation, type it like 7.072 x 10^3. Round to three significant figures where the question says so. Your best attempt counts.
